content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Briarstone Beverage Company's operating results improved over the year to September 30, 2026. Trailing revenue rose to {{fact:c4922b4c-807a-4712-a243-30f5312aee2f}}, EBITDA rose to {{fact:6456796e-0405-4ba2-a342-9b25b0acd376}}, and both financial covenants were met with cushion. The most important change is on the revolver: the borrowing base shows availability of {{fact:eccefdef-af40-4438-9a60-4bd6a41d5296}}, meaning the line is over-advanced. A critical work item on the over-advance has already been decided as paydown required, so the open question for review is whether that paydown has been completed."},{"section":"performance","body":"Trailing revenue increased from {{fact:f8aa12ba-a85b-41c9-8ef5-11ff64e11306}} to {{fact:c4922b4c-807a-4712-a243-30f5312aee2f}}, year-on-year growth of {{fact:22a26596-baab-4673-94ad-c27beca58cf8}}. EBITDA increased from {{fact:64207eb6-f9d2-412d-a5f1-0f33fad60f0f}} to {{fact:6456796e-0405-4ba2-a342-9b25b0acd376}}, with margin broadly steady at {{fact:12227f14-2a91-461d-8804-1af0b117e5e3}} against {{fact:4568689a-a70e-4e34-bd21-c157a566ff69}}. Net income rose from {{fact:709867d5-c628-41df-865b-c84036e18926}} to {{fact:6ed30b44-3a09-4584-a7f8-86acfcff4c33}}. Total debt fell from {{fact:ac5eaedb-4fa9-49b6-8838-66b125562c7c}} to {{fact:9de19762-919d-4c0a-8543-20a9da0dbb04}}, so leverage improved from {{fact:cffcd666-3bda-470f-81b1-4b5ade32868d}} to {{fact:3cec06e7-3792-4bd2-9197-6fd6c442a329}}, and interest coverage improved from {{fact:8b6cba29-ae00-4e7c-9085-c13e11c16bd2}} to {{fact:f926f862-270d-457f-a070-c7e0f5a57dd1}}. Working capital remains thin: the current ratio was {{fact:e5d5306a-f6a1-4367-b8f2-0f2094a7ec29}} against {{fact:a9960164-5b8b-41bb-b2b1-0580ab6356f9}}, DSO lengthened slightly from {{fact:b8cd9d73-b5ad-4257-aa79-5846e0aa5ebf}} to {{fact:53fae95e-9578-4056-a145-832306f4ed7f}}, DPO was unchanged at {{fact:3f0572e0-daad-4950-a17b-3e65e39475ab}}, and cash rose from {{fact:8ad5123b-5718-48bd-a305-599639c6a786}} to {{fact:6ab5f3d5-bc86-4025-a972-d109ea76ba07}}."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Both covenants were met, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculation on each. The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio was calculated at {{fact:11d5293c-2a58-4e46-9d46-3e79c4a75beb}} against a minimum of {{fact:456fe992-e534-4008-8b17-d303bb371185}}, a cushion of {{fact:7956938d-3364-459f-a14f-1a221b8d6508}}. The certificate reported {{fact:589668a3-6566-4ece-9273-7842b89fbb2a}}. The Total Leverage Ratio was calculated at {{fact:82e9ec86-8c71-43a6-aab3-cc9558e27931}} against a maximum of {{fact:d6c23ce9-9e4d-475a-a4cf-6f6e01c12823}}, a cushion of {{fact:a28c474e-2475-479b-9e5f-086366aafa9f}}. The certificate reported {{fact:00578aff-8a8a-4625-8adc-4e03de6e2cc4}}."},{"section":"collateral","body":"The borrowing base for the Revolving Line of Credit as of September 30, 2026 shows availability of {{fact:eccefdef-af40-4438-9a60-4bd6a41d5296}}. Revolver borrowings therefore exceed what the eligible collateral supports, and the line is over-advanced with no remaining cushion. No mismatched lines were flagged in the borrowing base. The facts provided do not show whether the shortfall arose from lower eligible collateral or from higher draws. A reviewer should look at the underlying borrowing base detail to determine the cause."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant item is the revolver over-advance. A critical work item was raised for this, and it has been decided with a paydown required. The facts provided do not show whether the paydown has been made, so a reviewer should confirm its status and timing. The availability-low early warning signal fired at medium severity on the same condition, with availability at {{fact:eccefdef-af40-4438-9a60-4bd6a41d5296}}. No other signals fired. The thin current ratio of {{fact:e5d5306a-f6a1-4367-b8f2-0f2094a7ec29}} matters more while revolver capacity is unavailable as a liquidity source."}]}
